milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue orchids are at ~-5 to ~-7, y=0, z=2-3 (spawn-relative). Target set to cluster center [-6, 0, 3] with max_distance=8 to require meaningful navigation toward the garden (not satisfiable from spawn). Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the flowers.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_blue_orchid instantly breaks it and drops a blue_orchid item (and a flower_pot) into the player's inventory. Blue_orchid is not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms the potted plant was mined. No tool required for instant-break.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_button drops the button item into the player's inventory. The button is at ~6 ~1 ~5 on the cottage exterior wall (attached to solid wall block at ~6 ~1 ~6, verified valid). Instant-break, no tool needed. Dark_oak_button is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark_oak_wall_sign is at ~5 ~2 ~10 on the interior back wall of the cottage, facing south. Max_distance=5 ensures the player is actually inside the cottage (cottage interior spans z=7-9, sign on back wall at z=10, so player must be at approximately z=5-10 range). Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the sign.

Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_stairs with the provided stone pickaxe drops the cobblestone_stairs item into inventory. Stairs are at ~-3 to ~-1, y=0, z=-3. Stone pickaxe is provided in starting inventory (required — cobblestone stairs drop nothing without a pickaxe). Cobblestone_stairs is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_sandstone_stairs with the provided stone pickaxe drops the red_sandstone_stairs item into inventory. Stairs are at ~-3 to ~-1, y=0, z=-5. Stone pickaxe is provided in starting inventory (required — red sandstone stairs drop nothing without a pickaxe). Red_sandstone_stairs is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because picking up an item means it appears in inventory. Checks for flower_pot which drops when potted_blue_orchid is mined (dependency graph ensures potted_blue_orchid is mined before this task is evaluated). Flower_pot is not in starting inventory and is guaranteed to drop without tools, making it the most reliable unique indicator.

Uses inventory_has because mining a hay_block drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. Hay blocks are at ~8-9, y=0, z=-2. Can be broken by hand (3.75s break time, no tool required). Hay_block is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 white_dye in 3x3 grid) produces 8 white_stained_glass items that end up in inventory. Player starts with 8 glass and 8 white_dye but no white_stained_glass. Crafting tables available at ~0 ~0 ~0 and ~6 ~0 ~8.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a red_bed (3 red_wool top row + 3 oak_planks bottom row) produces 1 red_bed item in inventory. Player starts with 3 red_wool and 3 oak_planks but no red_bed. Crafting tables available at ~0 ~0 ~0 and ~6 ~0 ~8.
